name: ki_extraction-4b-lmeval-llama3.1-instruct-synthetic_1-sft-on-lab_bench-0shot_cot-scillm-65010185
description: An evaluation suite derived from LLaMA 3.1 instruction-tuned synthetic supervised fine-tuning runs that measures a model's ability to extract and generate factual knowledge items from prompts under zero-shot chain-of-thought conditions. It focuses on knowledge extraction quality, fidelity of generated facts, and robustness of instruction-following when asked to produce structured knowledge. Tasks emphasize open-ended generation and information extraction from model internal knowledge.
reputation: Niche experiment / dataset on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside its creator's evaluations.
